subject.title: fix(codex): stop stale MCP child processes with revalidated SIGKILL escalation

question: Is a redacted Darwin Codex app-server lifecycle proof required before accepting forced SIGKILL escalation for this bundled Computer Use helper?
rationale: The new behavior runs only on macOS and changes a process-repair contract from SIGTERM-only to delayed forced termination; mocked tests and a Linux child transcript do not establish the actual platform-specific path.

options.title: Require macOS app-server proof
options.body: Request redacted terminal output or logs showing a real scoped SkyComputerUseClient child that survives SIGTERM, passes revalidation, and is then safely removed by SIGKILL.

options.title: Accept the platform gap
options.body: Merge based on the unit tests and generic Linux signal proof while accepting that the macOS helper lifecycle remains unobserved.

recommendation.title: Require macOS app-server proof
recommendation.body: Request redacted terminal output or logs showing a real scoped SkyComputerUseClient child that survives SIGTERM, passes revalidation, and is then safely removed by SIGKILL.

likelyOwner.reason: No prior merged-history owner could be established from the available read-only evidence; the Codex extension owner should make the platform-contract decision.
